post_close.note: Post-close session in the cash segment, trades at the closing price (para 4.2.4).

NSE_EQUITY.note: From 2026-08-03 this segment covers securities WITHOUT derivative contracts. Their closing price continues to be the VWAP of the last 30 minutes of continuous trading (para 4.1.2), so their timings are unchanged.

pre_open.note: Random closure in the last minute

session_2_order_entry_limit_only.note: No modification/cancellation of market orders; random close 09:08-09:10 (para 17.1.3).

NSE_EQUITY.cas_revision_note: The SEBI circular of 2026-10-15 changes no timing for securities without derivative contracts; the post-close session stays 15:50-16:00 (para 4.2.6).
NSE_EQUITY.etf_pre_open_note: From 2026-09-07 SEBI's norms for ETF base price, price bands, call auction in the pre-open session and close-out apply (SEBI HO/47/11/11(1)2026-MRD-POD3/I/13804/2026 dated 2026-06-15; start moved from 2026-09-01 by HO/47/11/11(1)2026-MRD-POD3/I/19839/2026 dated 2026-08-28). No session time changes.

NSE_EQUITY_DERIVATIVES.note: The equity derivatives segment operates up to 15:40 (para 4.2.3) — 10 minutes after the CAS order entry period closes. Index derivatives have no auction and trade continuously to 15:40. Dynamic price-band flexing for stock futures does not apply 15:15-15:40 (para 4.4.2).

revised_from_2026_12_07.expiry_day_note: On an expiry day, trading in the EXPIRING index derivatives contracts stops at 15:30 (para 4.2.4); other index contracts and all stock derivatives, expiring ones included, trade to 15:45 (paras 4.2.4, 4.2.5).
revised_from_2026_12_07.settlement_note: Expiring index derivatives settle on the index value computed from constituent VWAPs over the last 30 minutes of continuous trading in the cash segment; expiring stock derivatives on the underlying's VWAP over the same window across all exchanges (para 4.9.1).
revised_from_2026_12_07.price_band_note: Stock futures follow the CAS price band from 15:30 to 15:45; dynamic price-band flexing does not apply in that window (para 4.4.2).

NSE_EQUITY_DERIVATIVES.index_futures_price_band_note: From 2026-09-07 the CAS-aligned futures price band (+/-3% from a 15:00-15:15 VWAP reference) applies to index futures as well as stock futures, 15:15 to 15:40 (NSE/CMTR/76170 dated 2026-09-03, an update to NSE/CMTR/73362).

NSE_CURRENCY_DERIVATIVES.note: Configured as a daytime session; verify against the latest exchange circulars.

NSE_COMMODITY_DERIVATIVES.late_close_note: Internationally referenced contracts may extend to 23:55 during non-US daylight savings periods.

winter_2026_27.note: Times are subject to the trading-holiday and Muhurat circulars (NSE download no. 71784 dated 2025-12-15).

NSE_INTEREST_RATE_DERIVATIVES.note: Aligned to underlying NDS-OM timing changes if notified by the exchange.

special_session.note: Order cancellation session prior to market open.

sources.clearing_holiday_20260826_note: 2026-08-26 (Id-E-Milad) is a clearing holiday: equity cash and equity derivatives trade; currency, interest rate derivatives and corporate bonds are closed (NCL/MFSS/75777 dated 2026-08-17 and the NSE 2026 holiday list). Checked 2026-10-18.
